source_title: Phantom Blade Zero: All Accessories & Where to Find Them
source_excerpt:
Accessories are useful items that players can equip to gain passive effects, ranging from simply increasing damage output to improving dodge and parry timings, among other benefits. These items can be found throughout the game by defeating bosses, completing quests, opening certain chests, or picking them up from the ground.
Once you have some accessories, you can upgrade them by speaking to Jewel at the start of the third region. Upgraded accessories become much more powerful and can influence your build by themselves.
All Accessories in Phantom Blade Zero
There are three types of accessories in Phantom Blade Zero : Offensive, Defensive, and Support. Players can unlock a total of six accessory slots after acquiring all the upgrades, but they can only equip a maximum of three accessories from the same category at a time.
Keep in mind that some accessories are missable. You may need to complete certain quests before proceeding to the next region or select a specific dialogue option to obtain them. Make sure to check the locations below so you don't miss out on any useful accessories.
All Offensive Accessories in Phantom Blade Zero
Found from the first enemy right after the Lady’s Rift Bell.
Found from the group of enemies fighting after the First Meeting with Yu’er Bell.
After fighting the group of enemies north of Creek Valley Plains Entrance, defeat the archer and loot the golden chest nearby.
Inside a chest northeast of Abandoned Main Road Bell.
Inside a chest after you free Quick Hand Zhang.
Given by Quick Hand Zhang after you free him from the cage and meet him at his hideout.
Can be purchased from Quick Hand Zhang for 30k.
Return to Lanlan and Ju at the bridge and choose the option to accuse her , which starts a fight and rewards you with this accessory.
Complete Quick Hand Zhang's Request in the Village of Lu.
Use the Backstreet Courtyard Key and go upstairs.
From the Sealed Lion Bell, head north and use the Illusory Pipa to go through. Grab the accessory at the end.
Defeat Yubi, No. 21 Swordfighter Puppet.
Use the Preservation Jar after clearing the thorns with Flaming Mane at Meigu Village East Dock.
Loot the house after defeating One-Eyed Archer.
Found at Lake Banyan Dock, southeast of the region.
Found shortly after the Lady's Path Bell, after the woman on the ground dies.
After the cutscene with the Crusher, head upstairs and free the man in the cage.
Inside a chest in the building to the right of the Jade-Fang boss arena.
From the Nuo Mask Altar Bell, go down the path, then down the chain. Ahead, you will find a house with a door you can open. Defeat the enemies inside and grab the accessory.
Finish Quick Hand Zhang's Request in Mirage Estate.
All Defensive Accessories in Phantom Blade Zero
Go through a hole in a house near Axemaster's Holding Cell Bell.
Found near Crimson Manor Bell, east of Weeping Creek Valley.
Complete the Apprentice Healer quest.
Find both Preservation Talisman Fragments . The first is inside the cave with the dogs and fat enemy. For the second, use the Crimson Forest Tunnel Crank, head down the ladder, and check the item on the right.
Go south from the Burial Grounds Bell after entering Mirage Estate.
Found next to Jewel near the Place of Awakening Bell.
From the Well of the Three Puppets Bell, head left and keep going straight until you enter the building ahead with the powerful puppet. Defeat it to obtain this accessory.
From the previous flower, follow the main path until you can open the gate from the other side, creating a shortcut. Ignore the house with the underground path and go through the open archway. Head down the ladder and defeat the enemies to find a golden chest containing this accessory.
Talk to the thief near Smuggler's Tunnel Entrance after checking on the Thieves' Camp.
From the South Gate Bridge Bell, go straight and look to your right to see stairs leading to a golden chest.
Inside Huang Manor . Collect all the fragments inside to obtain this accessory.
From the Backstreet Rest Bell, follow the main path until you encounter some enemies alongside a Poison Powderkeg. Defeat them and open the chest at the end of the path.
Found inside a chest in a building west of the Green Serpent House Bell.
From the Pangzhen Docks, head towards the Sha-Chi Tower to find this inside a golden chest along the way. There will be a few enemies around the chest that you need to deal with first.
All Support Accessories in Phantom Blade Zero
Near Valley Sha-Chi Tower Base Bell. Put the Sha-Chi Furnace Inspection Crank in the slot next to the furnace.
Inside a chest next to the body you need to interact with for the Whence the Weeping story quest, at the extreme south of Weeping Creek Valley.
Inside a golden chest in Lady's Cave.
Give all the correct answers to Gentle Thief's Questions during the Honor Among Thieves quest.
Defeat Bai Chilian, the Sacrificial Serpent.
Inside the golden chest in the cave east of Thieves' Camp. You will need the Bastion Phantom Edge to access it.
Inside the chest before the Threadbound Great Tree Bell after entering Mirage Estate.
Bring the Prayer Beads from the Outpost in Weeping Creek Valley to Survivors' Courtyard and give them to the Monk, who will reward you with this accessory.
Complete the A Puppet's Wooden Heart tale.
Inside the Village of Lu Cellar , accessible with the key acquired near the end of this region.
Inside a chest near Black Hill Pavilion Bell. You will need Flaming Mane to reach it.
Complete the Xue, Admirer of Heroes quest.
From the Road to Training Grounds Bell, head forward. When you reach the open area with multiple enemies, go left and make your way onto the roof of the building. Drop down to find a chest.
Inside a chest at the White Serpent House.
Inside a chest in the Phantom Illusionist Ruins .
Inside a chest in the Phantom Illusionist Ruins near the third Bell.
Talk to Cui's grandfather near The Lady's Shrine Bell.
Before going down to the Training Grounds, take the path around a wooden log that you can jump over, then use the chain to descend. Head up the ladder on the left, defeat the enemy, and open the chest.
After acquiring all the pieces of the Nuo Mask, bring them to the Old Beggar to receive this accessory.
Defeat Qiu Feng, The Crimson Boneblade.
